boot.tip.1: Metin stones fall from the sky every minute or so. Break them before they awaken.
boot.tip.2: An awakened Metin calls elites and raises corruption, but pays far better.
boot.tip.3: Skills reach their final rank P at rank 8 and awaken with a special effect.
boot.tip.4: The Blacksmith never destroys your gear. A failed refine only costs materials.
boot.tip.5: Rarity decides how strong a card is. Luck raises your odds of rare cards.
boot.tip.6: Bosses carry gear for your class. Duplicates become Metin shards.
boot.tip.7: Resetting your talent points is always free. Try both doctrines!
boot.tip.8: Banish removes a card from your pool for the rest of the run.
boot.tip.9: Socketed stones upgrade up to +4. Swap out a weak one when a better one drops.
boot.tip.10: Each empire grants a permanent bonus: health, faster levelling, or better loot.
